(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) is a tight-tolerance fit feature, but the drawing specifies an I.Z.B.P. plating treatment without accounting for the added coating thickness on this bore. The plating will reduce the finished hole size and can cause interference with the mating shaft; the designer must either specify masking of the bore before plating or adjust the pre-plate machining dimension to allow for the coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the ⌀16 H7 bore is to be masked during plating, or increase the pre-plate bore diameter by twice the maximum plating thickness so the final plated size remains within H7 limits."}]}
